rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for assuming something is true in order to reason from it.

example.english: Let’s presuppose that this number is correct before we calculate further.
example.traditional: 我哋先假設呢個數字係正確，咁先計到落去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 gaa2 cit3 ne1 go3 sou3 zi6 hai6 zing3 kok3 gam3 sin1 gai3 dou3 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this conversational construction when treating A as if it were B for the purpose of an argument or calculation.

example.english: You can presuppose that this plot is a park and work out how many seats are needed.
example.traditional: 你可以當呢塊地係公園，先計吓要幾多個座位。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 dong3 ni1 faai3 dei6 hai6 gung1 jyun4 sin1 gai3 haa5 jiu3 gei2 do1 go3 zo6 wai2

rows.note: Use this mainly in technical or formal contexts when the assumption is built into the discussion from the outset.

example.english: These calculations presuppose that all participants arrive on time.
example.traditional: 呢啲推算預設所有參加者都準時到達。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 teoi1 syun3 jyu6 cit3 so2 jau5 caam1 gaa1 ze2 dou1 zeon2 si4 dou3 daat6
